idea: Exact rectangle table g(p,q,m): for integer rectangles p×q up to about 12 and counts m up to n, store the best sum from a single square, a uniform grid, or one guillotine cut. Compute it with memoised DP in exact Fractions. The unit square is then filled by trying every split of the 1×1 board at rational cut positions with denominators up to 12, which captures nested L-shapes and asymmetric cuts in one table.
